scripts.release:check: opdk release check && npm run scorecard:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run site:check
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.it: npm run build && npm --prefix integration ci && npm --prefix integration run it
scripts.it:matrix: npm run build && npm --prefix integration ci && npm --prefix integration run it:matrix
scripts.it:android: npm run build && npm --prefix integration ci && npm --prefix integration run it:android
scripts.it:typecheck: npm --prefix integration ci && npm --prefix integration run typecheck
scripts.it:lint: npm --prefix integration ci && npm --prefix integration run lint
scripts.capture: npm run build && CAPTURE=1 playwright test e2e/capture.spec.ts --reporter=list && opdk demo
scripts.e2e:record: npm run build && PWDEBUG=1 E2E_RECORD=1 playwright test e2e/record.spec.ts --headed --timeout=0
